fi|7df4ed19a4ca8fa0.en: The HUS group will establish a dynamic purchasing system (hereinafter 'the DPS') for the acquisition of process-controlled prostheses, which will target the acquisition of the HUS Assistants Centre (DPS) processor-controlled prostheses, a procurement based on an assessment of the means made in the framework of an individual needs acquisition.
